entries.en:
Convinced of the merits of Chaqurl Qhotl's argument, you express your support for his theory that the Qitari and the Viis enjoyed friendly relations from the earliest of days, a vote of confidence that pleases the child greatly. Grudgingly agreeing that his son may have a point, Qitarl Natl agrees to assist in the restoration of the second stela.

※Please note that the difficulty of this quest has been synced to your current level. Furthermore, you may not proceed with a class or job that is different from when you accepted this quest.

entries.en: Under your watchful eye, the Qitari artisans restore the second stela to Chaqurl Qhotl's best interpretation of its former glory. Encouraged and heartened by reclaiming a vital piece of their legacy, the Stewards now pursue their excavation efforts with newfound zeal. Continue to lend them your aid in their efforts should you so desire.
entries.fr: Les Qitari du plateau de Hopl célèbrent la restauration de la deuxième stèle légendaire. Mais les fouilles ne sont pas terminées pour autant<nbsp>!
entries.ja: ルリの発掘隊のキタリたちは、「第二の石碑」の復元完了を、とても喜んでいるようだ。これからも、キタリ族の発掘を手伝っていこう！

entries.en: You, too, saw how Master Lanille welcomed us when we visited Fanow, yes? Why, it is simply <italic(1)>post-preperous<italic(0)> to think that the friends of my great-great-great─and so on─grandmothers and grandfathers hunted us like vermin!

entries.en: Yes, I am quite certain that the Viis were our friends from the earliest of days. The Qitari in the markings is meant to be raising his hands in sheer joy. Surely you agree?
entries.fr: Deuxième stèle montrer scène de rencontre de Qitari et Viis. Qitari accueillir avec joie Viis, jolies et fortes. Bras levés pouuur exprimer joie de rencontrer nouvelles amies<nbsp>!
entries.ja:
「第二の石碑」は、キタリ族とヴィースの出会いの場面で、
弓がうまくてカッコいいヴィースを、大歓迎しているでござうよ。
ロンカに迎えるトモダチが増えて、大喜びしたはずにござう！

entries.en: If you elect to vouch for Chaqurl Qhotl's theory, the second stela will be restored to reflect his interpretation of history. Proceed, and you will be unable to view the stela as Qitarl Natl envisions it.
entries.fr: Si vous choisissez de soutenir la théorie de Chaqurl Qhotl, la stèle des Qitari sera restaurée selon cette hypothèse. Vous ne pourrez pas voir la version proposée par Qitarl Natl.
entries.ja:
「チャクルリ・コテル」の説を信じてストーリーを進行させると、
彼の説に基づき、石碑の復元が行われるようです。
「キタルリ・ナトル」の説での復元結果を見ることはできません。

entries.en: The rewards you receive and the content of the quests to follow will be the same regardless of the choice you make. You are free to choose the version of history you find most compelling.
entries.fr: Les récompenses que vous obtiendrez seront les mêmes dans les deux cas. Suivez donc vos convictions pour faire ce choix.

今後の友好部族デイリーのコンテンツ内容に、変化はありません。
あなたが語られるべきと思う歴史を、選択してください。
